name: UIZZE
tagline: Give Cline real UI evidence and a hard finish gate before it ships
description: Connect Cline to UIZZE's catalogue of 800,000+ real web and iOS screens. Search interface references and flows, create product-specific design contracts, validate implementation manifests, audit rendered output, and reject generic UI before release.

env.name: UIZZE_AGENT_TOKEN
env.description: Agent token created in the UIZZE Agent Connector.

install.notes: Create an agent token at UIZZE, set UIZZE_AGENT_TOKEN locally, and never commit it to a repository.
